description:
A researcher preparing a systematic review manuscript discovers that several key papers in their Zotero library are missing DOI (Digital Object Identifier) values. The target journal requires DOIs for all cited references that have them.

Your task is to locate the following 5 papers in the library and add their correct DOIs to the DOI field in the Info panel:

1. 'A Mathematical Theory of Communication' (Shannon, 1948)
   DOI: 10.1002/j.1538-7305.1948.tb01338.x

2. 'Computing Machinery and Intelligence' (Turing, 1950)
   DOI: 10.1093/mind/LIX.236.433

3. 'Molecular Structure of Nucleic Acids' (Watson & Crick, 1953)
   DOI: 10.1038/171737a0

4. 'Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition' (He et al., 2016)
   DOI: 10.1109/CVPR.2016.90

5. 'ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks' (Krizhevsky et al., 2012)
   DOI: 10.1145/3065386

Instructions:
- Select each paper in the main list.
- In the right-hand Info panel, find the 'DOI' field.
- Enter the exact DOI string listed above.
- Click away or press Enter to save.
- Do NOT include 'https://doi.org/' prefix, just the identifier (e.g., '10.1038/171737a0').

targets.title_substring: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
